_comment: Insert from Device, measured on FileMaker Pro 26.0.3 (macOS, 2026-10-12): each step was pasted into a script, FileMaker's displayed line read, and the step copied back (xml).

FileMaker draws the target bare first, then `Type:`, then the options the type keeps joined with `; `. lineHides names what the stored step holds that FileMaker's line cannot show: a barcode-type mask other than all types (4194303), and the flashlight mode of a barcode scan from the front camera. HR to XML of that line writes all barcode types and leaves the flashlight mode for FileMaker to fill (Auto).
